title: Executive slate + risk tradeoffs — Q3 2027 (WIP)
body:
Purpose

This is a working slate for the Q3 2027 executive update and accompanying all‑hands. Primary goals: 1) align leadership on top company priorities and the tradeoffs we need to accept to hit the quarter; 2) define the asks we will make of teams during the all‑hands (decisions, slashes, temporary task forces); 3) capture open risks and contingency triggers.

Note about state: this doc is intentionally rough. It captures suggested narrative, a short scenario analysis, and a pared set of slides/announcements we should be able to finalize in the executive rehearsal on 2026‑09‑10.

High level narrative (working)

- Momentum thesis: Redwood’s product and GTM motions have driven strong uptake for Hosted API but we are entering a period where Dedicated and Private deals will drive the next tier of revenue. Q3 is about shifting engineering attention to predictable capacity and enterprise readiness while not losing velocity on performance and cost improvements that keep PLG funnel healthy.
- What we are asking of the company: tighten priorities to the 3‑line focus below; accept temporary deprioritization of exploratory infra experiments (unless they directly reduce per‑token cost by >20% within 60 days); treat Dedicated go‑to‑market playbook as a top GCSD deliverable.

Proposed Q3 company priorities (top 3, measurable signals)

1) Deliver Dedicated baseline SLA and scaling runbooks (owner: Eng:Dedicated, lead: Marcus Li)
   - Signal: 2 enterprise deals in pilot with SLA compliance validated end‑to‑end by week 9
   - Metric: average p90 tail latency under 300ms on reserved pools; documented rollback plan
2) Reduce per‑token cost for common PLG workloads by 18% (owner: Serving Runtime + Optimize)
   - Signal: production canary showing cost delta on 3 sample apps; predicted unit cost model updated in Console
   - Metric: token spend per 1k requests down 18% vs baseline (May 2026)
3) Harden Private deployment onboarding and KMS integrations (owner: Private Deployments)
   - Signal: two successful VPC customer installs end‑to‑end with KMS/HSM
   - Metric: time to first inference under 48 hours from start of onboarding checklist

Tradeoff scenarios (short list for execs)

- Scenario A (Velocity bias): Keep most teams focused on PLG velocity and experiment runway. Pro: continued growth in Hosted signups and faster feature iteration. Con: slower enterprise readiness and fractional revenue miss on Dedicated bookings.
- Scenario B (Reliability + Enterprise focus — recommended): Shift 20–30% engineering heads to Dedicated/Private critical path for 8 weeks. Pro: higher probability of closing multi‑quarter contracts in H2. Con: momentum loss on new PLG features; short‑term metric dip in Hosted conversion.
- Scenario C (Cost‑first optimization): Aggressively target quantization + kernel work, diverting infra experiments into a two‑week sprint. Pro: material per‑token cost improvement, better gross margins. Con: potential regressions in model latency/quality and slower enterprise features.

Risks and triggers (what to watch for)

- Ramp risk: if Dedicated pools require >12 weeks to stabilize in customer pilot, escalate to Executive team and flip to fallback model routing for pilots (temporary Hosted burst). Trigger: two consecutive weeks of missed p95 latency SLA in pilot environment.
- Quality regression risk: model quantization changes lead to >5% drop in eval pass rate on critical prompt sets. Trigger: weekly evals show sustained degradation for 2 runs.
- Onboarding throughput risk: Private installs backlog >3 customers leading to >30 day onboarding delay. Trigger: backlog hits 3 and average time>30d.

All‑hands: proposed run of show (30–40 minutes)

- 0–5m: Founders: one slide, top narrative + the ask (what we need from the org)
- 5–12m: Product + Eng: three priority announcements (Dedicated SLA, cost initiative, Private onboarding update). Quick demo clip of Dedicated admin in Console (pre recorded).
- 12–18m: Customer spotlight (recorded) — focus on a pilot that demonstrates Dedicated value proposition
- 18–25m: Breakouts / micro‑asks (teams self‑select to action buckets: runbook contributors, eval owners, onboarding responders)
- 25–30m: Exec Q&A (moderated) + where to find the follow up action tracker

Communications plan (post all‑hands)

- Day 0 (all‑hands): publish short digest in #all‑company with 2 slides and the ask matrix; link to working docs and sign‑up sheet for task forces.
- Day 1–7: Product/Eng follow up emails with owners and specific deliverables.
- End of week 3: Exec check‑in for pulse and go/no‑go on rebalancing engineering allocation.

Decision map (what executives will sign off on at rehearsal)

- Approve 3 top priorities above (simple majority).
- Approve reallocation target: up to 25% of Eng capacity for 8 weeks (precise headcount and teams TBD by Eng SVP).
- Approve contingency budget of $250k for pilot burst capacity and professional services for Private installs.

Open questions (need answers before final slides)

- Exact headcount impact if we pull 25% capacity — requests to Eng SVP for a red‑lined list by 2026‑09‑07.
- Which two pilot customers are closest to being referenceable for the customer spotlight? (CS to confirm by 2026‑08‑25).
- What is realistic gating for quantization work to avoid eval regressions? (Research to propose a 3‑stage gating rubric).

Immediate next steps and owners

- Marcus Li: finalize Dedicated runbook outline and an operational checklist by 2026‑08‑25.
- Ava Martinez: draft the two all‑hands slides and record the Console demo clip by 2026‑08‑28.
- Sridhar Iyer: compile risk triggers and last 90‑day metrics for the executive rehearsal by 2026‑09‑03.
- Elena Park (owner of this doc): synthesize feedback from rehearsal and produce final exec slide deck by 2026‑09‑11.

Appendix (notes to self / talking points)

- Emphasize that this quarter is about tradeoffs, not wholesale strategy change. We are calibrating for revenue mix that includes larger Dedicated/Private deals.
- Reiterate that PLG health matters — we are not abandoning Hosted improvements. The ask is time‑boxed reallocation.
- Have a short FAQ ready: why prioritize Dedicated now; how will individual contributors be impacted; what metrics we will use to judge success.

Comments / scratch notes (informal)

- We should avoid heavy technical detail in the all‑hands — keep it strategic. Post the deep runbooks to the Eng library and link from the all‑hands digest.
- Consider a small gratitude token for teams that pick up onboarding work (e.g., bonus comp pool or public recognition).
- Keep language simple on pricing/commits — this is still a WIP with Sales.

-- end of working slate --
